china_race_dynamics.text: Quantum computing, which supercharges our technological capacities, is one of the most important technologies of this century. This legislation is essential to helping the United States cement its position as a global leader and outcompete China and other adversaries. [...] Our national security depends on our ability to invest in, scale and quickly deploy technologies like AI and Quantum.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the legislation is essential to outcompete China and cement US global leadership.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses outcompeting China as a policy priority.
